title: Decoding Across the Quantum LDPC Code Landscape
history: 2020 study of BP+OSD; cites Panteleev and Kalachev arXiv:1904.02703 (2019) as the original quantum BP-OSD proposal.
scope: Figure 3 regular BP curves only; BP+OSD-CS curves provide paper context but no OSD execution is requested.
codes: Toric [[162,2,9]], [[242,2,11]], [[338,2,13]], [[450,2,15]]. Symmetric HGP of closed-loop repetition checks, source Eq. (4); all redundant checks retained.
algorithm: Appendix C Algorithm 1: flooding min-sum, alpha_t=1-2^(-t), t starts at 1, no damping. Section V sets maximum iterations to code block length n.
channel: Section VI: binary X-only code-capacity experiment, p is X probability; symmetric independent X/Z components allow one species to be simulated.
metric: Block failure including nonconvergence and nontrivial logical residual. Both logical generators are tested. This is not a per-logical-qubit error probability.
rates: Every retained dashed-BP vector-plot vertex, cross-checked against its vertical error bar. Per-distance grids differ; no interpolation or invented points.
qbp: Additional canonical joint-Pauli min-sum with the same alpha schedule and T=n ceiling, depolarizing probability 1.5 times the source X rate. This is a controlled comparison with a different joint noise model.
qualification: Source-matched rule, schedule, rate grid and iteration budget; project row-major ring-HGP ordering and paired logical basis. Source author raw matrices, samples and floating-point conventions were not supplied. Statistical agreement remains to be assessed.
